technical: Document observed macOS 27 native Clock event, Now Playing and unattributed Gaming/Wine visibility, deferred system-item sorting and native overflow-adjacency limits without unsupported workarounds.
user: During management, native Clock clicks cannot open Notification Center, and Now Playing or unattributed Gaming/Wine items may disappear. Some system items cannot be sorted; adjacency to the overflow arrow is not guaranteed. See README for tested workarounds and recovery.
